text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not feeling at her best, Narita Taishin 
drags her feet as she makes her way out of 
the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once the gates open, there is nothing left 
that you can do for them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There was nothing left to do but simply 
pray for her safe return.
